items.verbatim: THIS PARTNER SPECIALIZES IN PRODUCING HIGH QUALITY HARDWOOD LUMBER, RAILROAD TIES, AND CANTS. WOOD IS SOURCED FROM PRIVATE LANDOWNERS AND STATE FORESTS, INCLUDING THE HOOSIER NATIONAL FOREST. THIS AWARD WILL ALLOW THE OPTIMIZATION OF THE EDGER SYSTEM AND THE ADDITION OF A CLEEREMAN GANG BOX. BY IMPR
